literal: In laziness, she, the dark goddess of misfortune, they say; of him who has no laziness, in the effort, he, she of the lotus.
translation: They say the dark goddess of misfortune dwells in laziness, while the Goddess of the lotus resides in the active effort of the one who is free from laziness.
modern: சோம்பல் உடையவரிடத்தில் கரிய மூதேவி தங்குவாள் என்றும், சோம்பல் இல்லாதவனுடைய முயற்சியிடத்தில் தாமரையில் வீற்றிருக்கும் திருமகள் தங்குவாள் என்றும் கூறுவர்.
explanation: This couplet contrasts the consequences of laziness and active effort using powerful symbolic figures. The poet states that 'மாமுகடி' (the dark goddess of misfortune and poverty) makes her home within laziness ('மடியுள்'). Conversely, 'தாமரையினாள்' (the goddess of the lotus, representing wealth and prosperity) resides within the persistent effort ('தாளுள்') of a person who is free from laziness ('மடியிலான்'). Through this imagery, the couplet teaches that sloth brings ruin, while hard work naturally attracts prosperity.
